name: Benziodarone

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and United Kingdom, first in 1964 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzbromarone
problems: Pulled from the market in France and Portugal, first in 2003 — for liver harm

similar.name: Benzarone
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1992 — for liver harm

similar.name: Amiodarone
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm, breathing problems and liver harm

summary: Benziodarone was pulled from the market in France and the United Kingdom starting in 1964 due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. Other drugs with similar chemical structures have also faced safety actions, such as Benzbromarone and Benzarone being removed from markets for liver harm, and Amiodarone receiving the strongest safety warning in the United States for heart, breathing, and liver harms [3][4][5].
